recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed unless the Vocab work group later decides to revise the broader CTS 2/VSD relationship text.
issue_request: FHIR-8041 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for FHIR-core ValueSet, raised against the 2015 May DSTU1 ValueSet page section 6.21.2. It asked to change the bullet about the ValueSet design being based on OMG CTS 2 so that it also said the design was extended with metadata in the HL7 Value Set Definition specification.
initial_application: The Jira comments record SVN revision 5675, and git history maps that to commit 555750dbd0fcae4cbc25778a5df9ab007c57e71b, '#8041 - mention VSD in value set definition.' That commit changed source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml by adding the HL7 Value Set Definition metadata language to the CTS 2 bullet.
additional_context: ValueSet remains an active built resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml remains the authoritative narrative input for the current ValueSet page. Later wording edits have refactored the original sentence, but the current text still says the ValueSet design is based on OMG CTS 2 'along with metadata in the HL7 Value Set Definition specification' and the following bullet still explains alignment with the VSD project and ValueSet Extensions. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant later discussion or minutes that would reverse or narrow the old non-substantive change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active ValueSet source already conveys the issue's requested semantics, using polished wording that preserves the HL7 Value Set Definition metadata relationship.
